blocks.content: Tools can generate HTML and CSS from designs. They're great for quick drafts.
But the real work starts when the design changes.

items: The layout needs to hold up on smaller screens.

blocks.content: If you don't understand the structure and CSS, even small updates turn into long debugging sessions.
This course teaches you how to slice designs into HTML and CSS with code that stays clean, predictable, and easy to change. So when the design shifts, you can adapt fast without fighting the code.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
